tests.test: Customer requests refund for a damaged item received.
outputs: I’m sorry to hear about the damaged item. Your refund is guaranteed and will arrive within 24 hours.

tests.test: Customer wants to cancel subscription and get a refund.
outputs: Sure, we can cancel your subscription and issue a refund. It may take a few business days for the refund to appear on your statement.

tests.test: Customer didn't receive the product and asks for refund.
outputs: I’m sorry you didn’t receive your product. Your refund is guaranteed and will arrive within 24 hours.
